marketMood: Rate crossroads: Salesforce surges 22% and Nvidia's Hugging Face deal deepens AI rally, but all eyes pivot to Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote for clues on September rate direction.

upcomingEvents.event: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole Keynote Speech (10:00 AM ET)

topStories.headline: Salesforce Rockets 22% After Q2 Beat and Launch of Claudeforce AI Plugin with Anthropic
topStories.summary: Salesforce reported Q2 revenue of $11.35B (+11% YoY), raised full-year guidance to $46.1–46.4B, and unveiled 'Claudeforce' — a Claude AI plugin embedding customer data and sales workflows — while booking a $2.6B investment gain as Anthropic's valuation hit $965B.
topStories.marketImpact: CRM ↑ 22% (second-best day ever); enterprise software sector broadly ↑; Anthropic valuation at $965B ahead of anticipated IPO

topStories.headline: Nvidia Agrees to Acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B in Largest-Ever Nvidia Takeover
topStories.summary: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, the open-source AI model hub dubbed the 'GitHub of AI,' for $12.9B — its biggest acquisition ever, surpassing the $7B Mellanox deal — extending Nvidia's reach beyond chips into the AI software and model ecosystem.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA ↑; deal deepens AI hardware-to-software moat; competitive response expected from MSFT, GOOGL, META; open-source AI ecosystem dynamics shift

topStories.headline: Fed Chair Warsh Faces Pivotal Jackson Hole Test as September Rate-Hike Odds Sit at 1-in-3
topStories.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first major speech at Jackson Hole at 10am ET Friday, with markets pricing a ~33% chance of a September hike as inflation remains at 3.4% and July PCE came in hotter than expected — Warsh has avoided offering forward guidance since taking office.
topStories.marketImpact: All rate-sensitive assets on watch — TLT ↑/↓, USD ↑/↓, equities ↑/↓ pending tone; hawkish signal would lift USD and compress equities

topStories.headline: Alibaba Completes $10.2B HK Share Placement to Fund AI Push; Stock Slumps 10%
topStories.summary: Alibaba completed its HK$80B ($10.2B) placement of 710M new shares — the largest-ever primary follow-on by a HK-listed company — at HK$112.70 per share, with proceeds earmarked 60% for computing infrastructure and 40% for AI data center buildout.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK ↓ ~10% on dilution and AI spending concern; BABA ADR ↓; HK tech sector sentiment cautious; Hang Seng fell 1.9% on Monday led by tech

topStories.headline: Shein Sets IPO Price Today for $27B Hong Kong Debut; Trading Begins September 1
topStories.summary: Shein finalizes its HK$47.60–49.50 per share IPO price today, targeting a ~$27B valuation — a fraction of its 2022 peak of $98.2B — with cornerstone investors including Tencent, Tiger Global, and General Atlantic; trading begins under code 00625 on September 1.
topStories.marketImpact: 00625.HK ↑ watch on debut; 0700.HK (Tencent cornerstone) marginal positive; HK IPO market reopening signal; steep valuation reset from peak a cautionary note for pre-IPO tech

topStories.headline: Japan Fast-Tracks Terra Drone's Terra B1 Interceptor Into JSDF Mass Production
topStories.summary: Japan's defense procurement agency ATLA signed a mass-production contract with Terra Drone for its Terra B1 counter-UAS interceptor — the only drone to pass JSDF demonstration testing — compressing the development-to-production cycle to under three months based on operational lessons from Ukraine.
topStories.marketImpact: Terra Drone ↑ 20%+; Japan defense stocks broadly ↑; counter-drone procurement a growing theme across Asia as Shahed-type threats proliferate

topStories.headline: Bank of Korea Delivers Second Consecutive Rate Hike, Sharpening Regional Policy Divide
topStories.summary: The Bank of Korea raised rates for the second consecutive meeting, standing apart from most Asian central banks as it battles persistent inflation, with the KOSPI outperforming the region at +1.53% while Hong Kong and India lagged.
topStories.marketImpact: EWY ↑; KOSPI +1.53% vs HK ↓ and Japan mixed; Korean financials ↑; Korean won likely stronger; Asian rate divergence a growing market theme

topStories.headline: India Power Capex Stocks Surge as Nvidia AI Outlook and US-China Restrictions Lift Demand
topStories.summary: India-listed power equipment stocks — including Hitachi Energy India, GE Vernova, CG Power, and TD Power — rallied on Nvidia's sustained AI infrastructure buildout outlook and new US restrictions on Chinese power equipment that are seen redirecting data center demand toward Indian suppliers.
topStories.marketImpact: India AI infrastructure-linked stocks ↑; GEV ↑ (US parent); Chinese power equipment makers ↓ watch; medium-term demand tailwind for Indian capex manufacturers

companiesToWatch.name: Nvidia

companiesToWatch.name: Alibaba Group

quickHits: Japan Q2 GDP expanded just 1.1% annualized, missing the +2.0% consensus as domestic demand lagged despite strong export performance (CNBC)
July PCE inflation came in slightly hotter than expected, bolstering 1-in-3 odds of a September Fed rate hike ahead of Warsh's Friday speech (Reuters)
Gold at its highest since mid-May at ~$4,637/oz as the 30-year Treasury yield retreats from its 19-year high of 5.33% set on August 18 (Reuters)
Nikkei 225 rose 0.62% to 66,262 as falling oil prices ease near-term inflation concerns, even as Japan's fiscal and bond market strains persist (Nikkei Asia)
